name: Camp fire in a stone ring
description: A camp fire about 1.2 m across: a ring of rough grey-brown stones, some blackened, round a bed of grey ash and glowing embers, two logs laid in a cross with three sticks leant together over them and low flames at the heart.

provenance.prompt: A ring of stones with crossed logs and embers, about 1.2 m across; anchors fire:camp and light:fire.
